assumptions: Turner 2004 parameters at 37 °C with dangles=2, as ViennaRNA's default model.
limits: One structure, the minimum; suboptimal and alternative structures are not reported.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the minimum-free-energy structure and its energy, which the outputs carry; no panel shows this tool yet (a recorded surface gap), so there is no panel reading to carry.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is the minimum-free-energy secondary structure of this sequence, and its free energy?

description: Minimum-free-energy secondary structure (dot-bracket + ΔG) of an RNA/DNA sequence (Turner-2004).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

seq.description: the RNA/DNA sequence (T read as U).
